title: CGAP MACS Live Dead Separation
author: Adam Hunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qz5dx86
materials: Count cells and viability using nucleocounter.

steps.title: Assess cell viability
steps.instruction: Prepare a single‑cell suspension, mix 1 part cells with 1 part trypan blue (1:1 dilution), count cells and determine viability; if viability is below 70‑80 % proceed with the Dead Cell Removal protocol.

steps.title: Aliquot required cells
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume needed (ml) from the required number of cells divided by the total cells, remove that volume of cells and place them in a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Prepare 1X Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Make 20 mL of 1X Binding Buffer by adding 1 mL 20X Binding Buffer Stock to 19 mL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 300 g, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads for every 10⁷ cells, mix well and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Pre‑wash magnetic column
steps.instruction: When 5 min of incubation remain, place the appropriate column on the QuadroMACS Magnetic Cell Separator: MS column if cell count < 2 × 10⁸, LS column if < 2 × 10⁹. Run 500 µL (MS) or 3 mL (LS) 1X Binding Buffer through the column, collecting the flow‑through in a waste 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to cells
steps.instruction: After the 15‑min incubation, add 1 mL (MS) or 3 mL (LS) 1X Binding Buffer to the cell mixture.

steps.title: Pass cells through column
steps.instruction: Run the cell suspension through the same column on the QuadroMACS Magnetic Cell Separator, collecting the effluent (the live cell fraction) in a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer
steps.instruction: After the cells have passed through, run 4 × 500 µL (MS) or 4 × 3 mL (LS) 1X Binding Buffer through the column, using the same Falcon tube to collect the effluent (live cells).

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected cells at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, then resuspend the pellet in 0.5–1 mL PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Prepare cells for Chromium
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell suspension to the appropriate volume in 0.04 % BSA in PBS required for loading onto the Chromium platform.
